If you're looking for **smart lock installation in Ascot Vale (VIC 3032)**, here are several well-reviewed local locksmiths that can install and configure most major smart lock brands:

- Nice Locksmiths – Based on Mt Alexander Road in Ascot Vale, offering locksmith services including digital lock installations.
- TLC Security Locksmiths – Essendon-based locksmith with experience in residential smart locks.
- Lockstar Locksmiths – Kensington locksmith providing 24/7 service and smart lock installations.
- Fast Brunswick Key Services – Nearby Brunswick locksmith with emergency and installation services.
- Digital Door Locks Pty Ltd – Melbourne specialist in digital and smart door locks, supplying and supporting a wide range of brands.

If you already have a smart lock, most installers will:
- Remove your existing lock.
- Install and align the new hardware.
- Configure the app, PINs, fingerprints, or access cards.
- Test the lock and show you how to use it.

Typical installation pricing in Melbourne is around **A$150–A$300** for a straightforward replacement, with additional costs if the door requires drilling, modification, or conversion from a mortice lock. [www.smartlockinstallation.com.au](https://www.smartlockinstallation.com.au/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

If you haven't bought a lock yet, I can also recommend models that suit your door (timber, security screen, apartment, or mortice lock) and your preferred ecosystem (Apple HomeKit, Google Home, Alexa, or Samsung SmartThings).
